scope: Trips root container UI and interaction behavior on Android and iOS

section_1_active_trip.presence: Renders prominently when an active trip exists in database
section_1_active_trip.controls: Day indicator, Current milestone stop card, Mark Visited button, Skip Stop button, End Trip button
section_1_active_trip.truth_boundary: Manual milestone advancement only; zero live tracking claims or GPS auto-advance

section_2_saved_trips.presence: Renders list of persisted itineraries with confirmed stop counts and days
section_2_saved_trips.controls: Stop preview chips, Start Trip action button, Delete dialog confirmation
section_2_saved_trips.reactive_updates: Instant re-render upon deletion or activation

section_3_saved_places.presence: Renders list of bookmarked destinations with photo thumbnails or initial badge
section_3_saved_places.controls: Category/district label, Bookmark unsave toggle button, Tap to view detail sheet/screen

empty_state.presence: Renders when activeTrip == null and savedTrips is empty and savedPlaces is empty
empty_state.visuals: Terracotta bookmark icon, calm explanatory copy, direct CTA buttons to Plan and Discover
empty_state.anti_vibe_check: Zero fake counters, zero neon gradients, zero decorative confetti
